description: Use this when the user wants another version of one of their AI designs (the app's Try again): makes a new design from the same answers as design_id. Uses 1 more credit, like the app (failed or refused attempts give it back). Check it with get_design. Requires a linked Charmotion account.

design_id.description: design_id from design_character, design_logo or list_designs.

name: retry_design

image_url.description: The finished image (PNG/WebP); the link works for 10 minutes.

name.description: The character description, or the brand name of a logo.

next_step.description: How to animate it: create_character_set (character) or start_motion (logo) with design_id.

title: Try a design again
